Name: Dinner Restaurant & Bar
Company description: Located in the heart of Oslo city, Dinner is a favorite among many, from lovers of traditional Szechuan and Cantonese cooking to those venturing to try Chinese food for the first time. Dinner’s roots lie in the dream of 3 brothers to share the best of their heritage with an innovative twist. Through hard work, skilled chefs, traditional recipes, and one big dream, Dinner opened its doors to the Norwegian public the year of 1989. Over the past 22 years, it has evolved into one of the most well known restaurants in Oslo, and perhaps in all of Norway.   Today, Dinner has ca. 80 employees, many of which have been with the restaurant for 10 years and others ever since it first opened. Most of the dishes that brought Dinner to fame are still on the menu, and even follow the original recipe. The restaurant with seating for up to 184, is divided into two levels and two private rooms. Dinner has received national acclaim in Aftenposten, Dagbladet,  Dagsavisen, Citiguide Concierge and IN Magasinet, as well as International acclaim in Michelin Guide and Fodor’s.

Name: Protocol 47 AS
Company description: Protocol 47 is Norway’s premier luxury travel and diplomatic concierge, dedicated to curating one-of-a-kind experiences across Norway and Scandinavia. We serve HNWIs, dignitaries, royalties, celebrities, and global leaders, delivering journeys defined by discretion, authenticity, and excellence.  Guided by international protocol standards and aligned with the United Nations 17 Sustainable Development Goals, we ensure every experience reflects integrity, sustainability, and cultural respect. Beyond luxury travel, Protocol 47 plays a pivotal role as a business concierge, opening doors between international companies and government subsidiaries from Norway to the GCC countries, fostering collaboration and cross-cultural connection. Our privileged access extends to Norway’s most exclusive accommodations; from architect-designed villas and royal farms to secluded mountain lodges, private islands, and oceanfront cabins. Alongside partnerships with esteemed hotel brands such as De Historiske and Strawberry Hotels. Accompanied by our team of experienced protocol officers, guests enjoy seamless coordination, refined hospitality, and a genuine immersion into the Norwegian lifestyle, where nature, elegance, and diplomacy intertwine.Our operations adhere to international protocol standards and align with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN 17 SDGs), ensuring that every experience reflects excellence, responsibility, and respect for people and the planet. Beyond luxury travel, Protocol 47 also serves as a business concierge, facilitating meaningful connections and opening doors between international companies and government subsidiaries from Norway to the GCC countries; bridging cultures through diplomacy, discretion, and trusted relationships. Our guests & clients include: families, couples, executive groups, diplomatic delegations, adventurers, official visits, HNWIs, celebrities, royalties, and special projects.

Name: Shyer AS
Company description: Shyer ble etablert i 2021 av gründere med bakgrunn fra noen av Norges største IT-miljøer. Vi ønsket å gjøre ting annerledes: flytte fokuset fra generiske løsninger til ekte service og teknologi som faktisk virker. I dag er vi den eneste IT-partneren i Norge med et tydelig spesialfokus på hotell- og overnattingsbransjen. Vi kjenner hverdagen til hotellsjefer uten IT-avdeling, driftssjefer med hundre baller i luften og ansatte som bare vil at alt skal fungere. Men vi stopper ikke der. Teknologien vi bygger for hoteller fungerer like godt i bygg og eiendom generelt, fordi kravene til stabilitet, sikkerhet og brukervennlighet er de samme. Er det godt nok for en heldigital hotellkjede, er det godt nok for de fleste næringsbygg. Vårt oppdrag er enkelt: Vi bygger teknologien som får opplevelser og bygg til å skinne, og folk til å komme tilbake. Det betyr stabile nettverk, skjermer og systemer som spiller på lag med menneskene som bruker dem, og som gjør hverdagen enklere, ikke mer komplisert. Når innsjekken stopper opp, skjermene henger eller nettverket faller ned, er vi de som står i kulissene og får alt til å flyte igjen. Vi er små nok til å være alltid på hugget, og store nok i erfaring til å levere på nivå med – eller bedre enn – de største aktørene. Kort sagt: Vi er bransjens IT Concierge🫡☁️

Name: Ondego
Company description: Ondego is changing the way you use your smartphone. Battery life is the single biggest problem we have with our smartphones. Surveys rate it as a bigger problem than the next three issues combined. It’s the one feature that matters most (more than web access) – yet 80% of us charge our phones every single day, and a third of us 2+ times a day. Most of us don’t take our chargers everywhere we go – we find ourselves planning around charging, borrowing others’ chargers, and always running low. Even when we bring chargers, we’re constantly on the hunt for that elusive outlet. Enter Ondego. We’ve built a network of super-portable chargers that fully charges your phone in under an hour, wherever you happen to be. Whether you’re at your favorite bar, restaurant, coffee shop, hotel, on vacation at the beach, taking part in a startup conference, or even at the gym, we’ve got you covered. Just ask your bartender or concierge for a Ondego, plug it into your phone, and get back to doing what you do best.
